These display projections are fitted to all rows in the selected cohort. Their axes are separate for each encoder. The scores below use independent training-only projections and held-out data.

Cross-view retrieval

Accuracy (%), higher is better. Six 60° test sectors with 15° guards. “≥90°” restricts all gallery candidates to views at least 90° away. Changing the target changes scoring only; the gallery match and category-supervised PLS fit stay fixed.

Heading prediction

Mean absolute circular error (degrees), lower is better. These PLS models predict pose; the PLS display above uses category labels.

What this comparison can establish

The source views, masks, labels, split definitions and probe grids match. Encoders retain their native processing: masked CLIP inputs are square-padded; EG2 and DINO begin from native masked RGB, with DINOv3 at 256 pixels. This is not a compute or pixel-budget matched experiment.

PCA128 supplies an equal-dimension retrieval control. PLS dimensions are selected on validation rows only. Higher same-category similarity can reflect collapsed features; retrieval checks whether useful distinctions survive.

The scenes contain authored vehicle and paint categories, not independently verified physical identities. Sim2 elevation is unknown. Polar views are excluded from these heading plots and retrieval scores; their nominal rotation is reported separately. This study does not establish Bayesian tracking likelihood calibration or field performance.
